sbe:message.name: Hello
sbe:message.description: First message on a connection, and after each reconnect: who I am, which version and extensions I speak

field.name: PeerEpoch
field.description: the sender's process start, ns since the Unix epoch

field.name: ProtoVersion
field.description: highest SPP version the sender speaks

field.name: MinProtoVersion
field.description: lowest SPP version the sender accepts; both sides use min(highest, peer highest), refused below either minimum

field.name: Flags
field.description: 0; reserved

field.name: ServiceName
field.description: e.g. spwsgw, spwsgw-snap, the agent name

sbe:message.name: Status
sbe:message.description: Outcome of a request that has no richer reply; UNSUPPORTED answers anything the receiver does not implement

field.name: Reason
field.description: code-specific detail, 0 if none

data.name: Text
data.description: UTF-8, for logs; may be empty

sbe:message.name: RecapRequest
sbe:message.description: Agent to snapshot service: state of one instrument as of a sequence

field.name: CorrelationId
field.description: the request id, unique per agent epoch

field.name: Instrument
field.description: the instrument as on the wire

field.name: LastSeqSeen
field.description: last sequence the agent saw on the partition, 0 if none

field.name: SourceEpochSeen
field.description: publisher identity the agent sees, 0 if unknown

field.name: Venue
field.description: the venue as on the wire, 0 if unmapped

field.name: Flags
field.description: 0; reserved

sbe:message.name: RecapBegin
sbe:message.description: Opens a reply: the records that follow are the instrument's state as of AsOf

field.name: AsOf
field.description: S: the live sequence the state is consistent with

field.name: SourceEpoch
field.description: publisher identity the state was built from, 0 if unknown

field.name: RecordCount
field.description: records to follow, 0 if not known up front

field.name: Flags
field.description: 0; reserved

sbe:message.name: RecapRecord
sbe:message.description: One record of a reply: a stream message in the stream's own encoding, bytes as the publisher sent them

field.name: RecordCount
field.description: records sent

sbe:message.name: RecapReject
sbe:message.description: The service cannot answer; replaces a reply

sbe:message.name: Republish
sbe:message.description: Ask a publisher to publish an instrument's state again on its live stream; answered by Status

field.name: Instrument
field.description: 0 = every instrument

field.name: Flags
field.description: 0; reserved

sbe:message.name: SourceState
sbe:message.description: Publisher to its subscribers, one-to-many on the publisher's state stream: whether an instrument's in-band state can be trusted, as of a data-stream sequence

field.name: CorrelationId
field.description: the Republish being answered, 0 if unsolicited

field.name: SourceEpoch
field.description: the publisher's process start, ns since the Unix epoch; a new value means the data stream's sequence restarted

field.name: Instrument
field.description: the instrument as on the wire; 0 = the whole source (the periodic beat)

field.name: Sequence
field.description: last data-stream sequence published before this state took effect; apply it once the data stream has reached it

field.name: Venue
field.description: the venue as on the wire, 0 if unmapped

field.name: Flags
field.description: 0; reserved

sbe:message.name: Extension
sbe:message.description: Envelope for an extension: routed by ExtensionId, Body opaque to everyone but the extension's endpoints

field.name: ExtensionId
field.description: 1-0x7FFF assigned by subplane (docs/protocol/extensions.md), 0x8000-0xFFFF private

field.name: ExtType
field.description: message type within the extension

field.name: Flags
field.description: bit 0 must-understand, bit 1 reply expected
